meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 调试并修复 LazyCodex 或上游 Codex 的具体 bug。修复在临时工作区实现并验证;若缺陷来自 openai/codex,就通过 fork 提交 PR;若属于 LazyCodex 及其相关项目,则以带验证补丁的 issue 提交,决不 PR。最后清理临时文件并返回链接。
howto.when: 当用户请求修复 LazyCodex/Codex 的缺陷、为 bug 提交 PR,或进行相关调试时触发。

say.text: 修复 LazyCodex 里的这个 bug,并作为验证修复 issue 提交。
say.note: 会先在临时区复现、修复并附上补丁。

say.text: 排查 openai/codex 的这个缺陷,修复后从 fork 发 PR。
say.note: 会产出含复现日志和回归测试的 PR。

say.text: 调试这个 Codex 问题,给个最小正确修复。
say.note: 该技能会先判断归属再走对应交付。

howto.what_en: Debugs a LazyCodex/Codex bug, applies the smallest fix, and verifies it in a temp workspace. For openai/codex, ships a fork PR; for LazyCodex-owned repos, files a verified-fix issue (never a PR). Cleans up and returns links.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to fix a LazyCodex/Codex defect, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug such an issue.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in LazyCodex and file a verified-fix issue.
say_en.note: It reproduces, patches, and opens an issue with the diff.

say_en.text: Debug this openai/codex defect and open a fork PR.
say_en.note: It includes repro logs and a regression test.

say_en.text: Debug this Codex issue and give the smallest correct fix.
say_en.note: It routes to issue or PR based on ownership.
